name: India DPDP Act, 2023 (technical safeguards)
disclaimer: Indicative engineering view of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023: section 8(5) reasonable security safeguards, section 8(6) breach intimation, and section 16 cross-border transfer. It is not legal advice. Check the current Act, the DPDP Rules and any sector regulator requirements (for example RBI or SEBI) with counsel.

controls.title: Safeguards: backup so personal data is not lost
Safeguards: logging and monitoring to detect compromise
Ability to detect and investigate a breach so the Board and affected people can be informed
Cross-border transfer: visibility of where personal data is stored
